purpose: Protocol-frozen holdout evaluation of v8 evidence-gated method routing on newly selected physical formulation experiments.

freeze.result_policy: A full result is valid only after status is frozen, both revisions identify the preceding committed candidate, and evaluation_fingerprint matches the algorithm, adapter, data, dependencies, and normalized protocol.

threshold_rule.rationale: Fixed-prevalence evaluation device within each solid-lipid context; not a drug-product specification.

mechanism_features.name: total_lipid_input
mechanism_features.basis: Total solid and liquid lipid input defines the formulation lipid pool.

mechanism_features.name: liquid_lipid_fraction
mechanism_features.basis: Liquid lipid relative to total lipid captures formulation phase balance.

mechanism_features.name: drug_to_lipid_ratio
mechanism_features.basis: Drug input relative to total lipid is a standard formulation ratio.

mechanism_features.name: surfactant_to_lipid_ratio
mechanism_features.basis: Surfactant input relative to total lipid captures stabilizer loading.

claim_boundary.permitted_if_passed: On the frozen v6 finite-pool LNP3 evaluation, v8 method routing required fewer additional result queries than every preregistered baseline while preserving success-rate and solid-lipid-context guardrails.
not_permitted: The same reduction applies to another formulation, material, factory, process, or objective.
Finite-pool replay proves continuous-space or prospective production-cycle reduction.
Preregistered ratio features are validated physical laws or confirmed causes.
Inspected v3, v4, or HPLC outcomes are independent evidence for v6.
